scope: Batch 9 extraction from the untagged 2014-2015 Khans of Tarkir / Fate Reforged / Dragons of Tarkir Magic Story pages. Also the 2018 Chronicle of Bolas pages set on Tarkir. Three timelines appear: the Khans present, Tarkir's past (Fate Reforged) and the rewritten dragonlord present (Dragons of Tarkir). Each leader claim says which. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; targeted, not exhaustive; not owner approved.

claims.subject: surrak

evidence.quote: Perhaps you've seen Surrak Dragonclaw, the khan of the Temur clan.

claims.summary: Surrak Dragonclaw is khan of the Temur (Khans of Tarkir present).

claims.subject: narset

evidence.quote: Narset is the Khan of the Jeskai.
until the elders saw to appoint me the khan of the Jeskai

claims.summary: Narset was appointed khan of the Jeskai by its elders (Khans of Tarkir present).

claims.subject: narset

evidence.quote: He even had the honor of being trained by the khan of the Jeskai, Narset.

claims.summary: Narset trained Taigam.

claims.subject: taigam

evidence.quote: Taigam, my old pupil, who had betrayed the Jeskai to seek riches with the Sultai

claims.summary: Taigam, Narset's former pupil, betrayed the Jeskai.

claims.subject: taigam

evidence.quote: who had betrayed the Jeskai to seek riches with the Sultai

claims.summary: Taigam left the Jeskai to seek riches with the Sultai.
claims.limitation: Narset says he went to 'seek riches with the Sultai'; formal membership is not stated in this sentence.

claims.subject: sidisi

evidence.quote: The crown had once been taken by Sidisi herself, off of the freshly severed head of the previous khan.
Like all Sultai khans, she had proven her abilities of trickery and ruthlessness

claims.summary: Sidisi took the Sultai crown from the previous khan and rules as khan (Khans of Tarkir present).

claims.subject: yasova_dragonclaw

evidence.quote: But I saw that the storms would cease if I helped a malevolent dragon spirit kill the great Ugin.

claims.summary: Yasova tells the khans she had a vision that the dragon storms would cease if she helped a malevolent dragon spirit kill Ugin.
claims.limitation: The page never names the 'malevolent dragon spirit'; identifying it as Nicol Bolas is an inference from the wider Tarkir story.

claims.subject: sarkhan_vol

evidence.quote: After he created a magical, protective hedron cocoon around the fallen Ugin

claims.summary: Sarkhan created a protective hedron cocoon around the fallen Ugin.

claims.subject: ojutai

evidence.quote: he learned that a dragon called Ojutai ruled in her stead

claims.summary: In the rewritten present, the dragon Ojutai rules the Jeskai territory instead of Narset.
claims.limitation: Dragons of Tarkir present (after Sarkhan's change to history); the page says Ojutai rules 'in her stead' over the river lands where Narset had been khan.

claims.subject: zurgo

evidence.quote: for in that time she fell at the hands of Zurgo Helmsmasher, the khan of the Mardu

claims.summary: In the original (Khans) timeline, Narset fell at the hands of Zurgo Helmsmasher, khan of the Mardu.
claims.limitation: Only in the original timeline; in the rewritten timeline this page follows a living Narset.

claims.subject: dar

evidence.quote: But with Dar being born the day before her, with the way he held himself over Kela

claims.summary: Dar and Kela are the Chensal twins.
claims.limitation: Twinship comes from the page title and Dar calling Kela 'twin'; the quoted sentence names them as siblings born a day apart.

claims.subject: arcades_sabboth

evidence.quote: The expanding realm of our brother Arcades dwelt far away from the mountain of our birth.

claims.summary: Ugin calls Arcades his and Nicol's brother.
claims.limitation: Ugin narrates this section of the Chronicle of Bolas; 'our' means Ugin and Nicol Bolas.

claims.subject: chromium_rhuell

evidence.quote: Chromium Rhuell might speak sensibly
He wasn't my twin, after all, just a wingbeat sibling

claims.summary: Ugin describes Chromium Rhuell as a 'wingbeat sibling', not his twin.
claims.limitation: Ugin narrates this section of the Chronicle of Bolas; 'our' means Ugin and Nicol Bolas.

claims.subject: merrevia_sal

evidence.quote: No wonder four dragon skulls had joined that of our sister, Merrevia Sal

claims.summary: Merrevia Sal was Ugin and Nicol's sister; her skull adorns a human settlement's gate.
claims.limitation: Ugin narrates this section of the Chronicle of Bolas; 'our' means Ugin and Nicol Bolas.

claims.subject: nicol_bolas

evidence.quote: That dragon, called Bolas, killed Ugin.

claims.summary: Yasova (Grandmother) tells the twins that Bolas killed Ugin, and that she saw his body.
claims.limitation: Original timeline, as Yasova recounts it; Sarkhan's hedron cocoon later let Ugin survive.

claims.subject: nicol_bolas

evidence.quote: I was merely a tool used by a power greater than myself. That dragon, called Bolas, killed Ugin.

claims.summary: Yasova says a voice made her a tool of a greater power, and names Bolas as Ugin's killer.
claims.limitation: She does not say in so many words that the voice was Bolas; the link is from adjacent sentences.

claims.subject: naiva

evidence.quote: Baishya took hold of her elbow as if she thought her twin couldn't take the hint.

claims.summary: Naiva and Baishya are twins of the Atarka tribe.
claims.limitation: That they are Yasova's grandchildren is not established by this quote; they call her 'Grandmother'.
